thread:
Carla: hey team — overnight evals flagged a noticeable spike in failures for the short-sequence cohort on rdx-v1-int4. Quick summary: across instruction-coherence & short-answer suites we see ~12% pass->fail delta vs baseline. Can someone triage?

EvalBot: automated overnight report: https://internal.redwood/evals/1739004321
- model: rdx-v1-int4
- cohort: shortseq (<= 16 tokens)
- failing suites: instruction-coherence, short-answer-exact-match, brief-summary
- metric deltas: coherence_score -0.18, exact_match -0.12, avg_response_len -72%
- sample failures (first 5): blank/empty responses, truncated sentences, unexpected tokens

Ajay: is this correlated with the int4 rollout from yesterday? @Tom did the small-batch kernel change hit any serving pools?

Tom: I only pushed the int4 small-batch kernel to staging at ~03:10 UTC, not prod. But there was a config flip in the bring-up job that toggles tokenizer trimming for quant paths — i'm going to check that.

Megan: i'll take ownership for initial triage. setting severity P2 for now until we confirm customer-facing impact. will try a local reproduce and dump traces.

Megan: reproduce command i'm running:
```
nightly-eval run --cohort shortseq --model rdx-v1-int4 --seed 42 --samples 200
```
Sample failing output: "" (empty string) or "Answer:" with no content for ~20% of cases.

Ajay: can you also capture kvcache hit rates and tokenization lengths? if avg_response_len dropped maybe tokenizer/padding got trimmed incorrectly.

Megan: quick log snippet from one failing run:
```
[2025-06-09T03:24:12Z] sample_id=982 tokenized_len=14 response_length=0 generation_time_ms=11 kvcache_hits=0
[2025-06-09T03:24:12Z] sample_id=983 tokenized_len=12 response_length=0 generation_time_ms=10 generation_error=null
```
Seems like the model returns 0-length outputs without throwing a generation error.

Tom: that lines up with an off-by-one in the tokenizer trim path I saw when testing int4 wrapper earlier. the quant path uses a different post-processing trim that can strip all tokens when pad_id handling is wrong. i'll diff the tokenizer wrapper and push a hotfix branch. @Megan try re-running with --tokenizer-override=/tmp/tokenizer-v2 to force the new path.

Megan: re-run with override now. result: failures dropped to ~1.5% on the same sample set. looks like tokenizer was the culprit. i'll run longer and validate.

Carla: great catch. Megan keep the hourly updates, Tom open a PR for the fix and link here. If failures persist above 5% after fix, we'll escalate to P1 and notify support. :thumbsup:
